sources.instructions: Stage a complete owned Nuclear Dawn dedicated server tree so nucleardawn/maps/hydro.bsp exists. Anonymous SteamCMD app 111710 installs only a partial tree. Do not use an unofficial archive.

Steam app 111710 is the Nuclear Dawn dedicated server. Anonymous SteamCMD installs a partial tree without nucleardawn/maps/hydro.bsp. Setup with an entitled profile downloads that app for Linux and does not fall back to anonymous. Do not use an unofficial archive.

manual_reason: Import requires a complete compatible distribution and manual staging. See assets requirements for this game.
